title: viburnum opulus subsp. typicum
intro: Viburnum opulus subsp. typicum, commonly known as Guelder Rose or European Cranberrybush, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe and Western Asia, known for its fragrant white flowers and red berries. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum opulus subsp. typicum include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds may also contribute to the plant's antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
